dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Brooklyn is at risk due to behavioral reasons. In his previous home there was a bite incident involving the resident dog. This bite resulted in punctures on the resident dog's neck. During his current stay in the care center, Brooklyn has been observed to be stressed while in care: noted to finger paint his kennel due to steady pacing, barking, and drooling. These behaviors were noted in his previous stay as well. With handlers, Brooklyn allows handling, enjoys long walks, placing sweaters on him, enjoys pets, and will allow handlers to clean him up coming out of his kennel. Medically, Brooklyn is apparently healthy.

Brooklyn arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. In his previous home there was a bite incident involving Brooklyn and the resident dog. The two dogs were playing with a rope toy when the owner stated that they began making more noise than usual. The owner went into the room and noted that the resident dog had puncture wounds on his neck. During his current stay in care, Brooklyn has been aloof with handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only, single pet home, with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Brooklyn
